title: Solitaire: Shattered Foil Edition
summary: A contemplative solitaire experience inspired by the art of stained glass and Tiffany copper-foil craftsmanship. Reimagines classic card gameplay with translucent colored glass, copper solder seams, and rich historical variations.
returnValue: Mindful, tactile card puzzles, historical solitaire lineage, and 24 handcrafted stained-glass deck collections.
